messages.body_plain:
Dear Gaurav, thanks for volunteering to administer the R project's participation in Google Code-in. Please prepare an application!

Usually it is good to have a co-administrator... do you know anyone else who could help you with the admin duties? Again I'm sorry but I probably won't have time to commit to being an admin for GCI this year.

Also after talking to some others who have participated in GCI in previous years, it seems like you need to find mentors who can commit a lot of time to helping the GCI students, especially in the first weeks of student coding (during which there are many eager students who need technical advice). I guess you could start by asking GSOC mentors if they want to participate in GCI.

Finally I think you should set up a wiki page with a table for possible GCI projects (like we had for GSOC on the RWiki http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2014). However the Rwiki is down so perhaps you could create a new GSOC/GCI-R group and wiki page on GitHub?

On Tuesday, October 28, 2014 1:22:00 PM UTC-4, Gaurav Sehrawat wrote:
> I am willing to setup as a volunteer for mentoring/admin in Google Code-In . I  completed GSoC for R-project in 2013 as a student. Just want to give back to community .
> Please consider me .
>
> Thanks
